answer_1.quote: Among NLG tasks, summarization is one of the most difficult to evaluate automatically.

answer_2.quote: We proposed QU E S TEV A L, a new reference-less metric, which is found to improve the correlation with humans judgments.
automatic_metrics: QU E S TEV A L

answer_4.guideline: i) Consistency: the proportion of facts in the summary corresponding to facts in the original text; ii) Coherence: how well-structured and well-organized is the summary; iii) Fluency: how fluent the summary is to read; and, iv) Relevance: the ratio between important and excess information in the summary.
